title: Version-bound assurance certificate freshness
problem: A previously valid PASS trace can become stale when evidence, analysis code, model rules, or declared dependencies change.

model.certificate_snapshot: sorted mapping of dependency id to bound revision
model.current_state: current declared mapping of the same dependency universe
stale_if: a new declared dependency is added

invariants: A stale PASS certificate is not a current PASS certificate
Dependency-set changes trigger reassessment even when old inputs are unchanged
boundary: Revision equality is necessary for reuse but not sufficient for scientific validity; unchanged evidence can still be wrong.
